notablePrerequisites: At least two of your opponents have a creature card in their graveyard.
description:
Cast Ghouls' Night Out by paying {3}{B}{B}, returning Salvager of Secrets from your graveyard to the battlefield, and at least two other creatures from your opponents' graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Salvager of Secrets and the creatures enter the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers once for each creature, and Salvager of Secrets triggers once.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Ghouls' Night Out from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve all Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating that many 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing Salvager of Secrets, two creatures your opponents own, and two Unicorns, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
